heading: Receipt Tracker
intro: Upload a receipt image, check its frame, and recognize its text.
uploadHint: JPEG, PNG, or WebP, up to 20 MB.
previewInstructions: Drag the four points onto the receipt corners. Use the arrow keys for fine adjustments; hold Shift for larger steps.

errors.unsupportedType: Please choose a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image.
errors.tooLarge: The image must be no larger than 20 MB.
errors.invalidUpload: The image could not be accepted. Check its type and contents.
errors.invalidImage: The image could not be processed. Choose another image.
errors.workerUnavailable: Image processing is unavailable right now. Try again later.
errors.uploadFailed: The preview could not be created. Try again.
errors.network: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.previewUnavailable: The preview image could not be loaded.
errors.invalidCorners: The corners do not form a valid receipt frame. Adjust them and try again.
errors.scanNotFound: The preview is no longer available. Upload the image again.
errors.processingFailed: The receipt could not be processed. Check the frame and try again.
errors.archiveUnavailable: The processed receipt image could not be loaded.
errors.ollamaUnavailable: Receipt extraction is unavailable right now. Try again later.
errors.ollamaFailed: The receipt data could not be extracted. Try again.
errors.invalidExtraction: The extracted receipt data could not be processed. Try again.

archiveAlt: Cropped archive image of the receipt
noOcrText: No text was recognized on this receipt.

review.heading: Review receipt
review.hint: Check and correct the recognized details.
review.lookupError: Saved entries could not be loaded.

sum.MATCH: The item sum matches the receipt total.
sum.MISMATCH: The item sum differs from the receipt total. Check prices and discounts.
sum.INCOMPLETE: The sum cannot be checked yet. Complete missing or invalid amounts.

warrantyIssues.missing: Enter a start and end date.
warrantyIssues.range: The end date must be on or after the start date.

issues.purchaseDate: Purchase date is missing or invalid.
issues.currency: Currency must contain three uppercase letters.
issues.quantity: Item {{number}}: quantity must be greater than zero.
issues.itemTotal: Item {{number}}: total is missing or invalid.
issues.packageAmount: Item {{number}}: package amount must be greater than zero.
issues.discountAmount: Discount {{number}}: amount must be greater than zero.
